market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance is one of the world's most valuable private companies (~$300B); if it IPOs in 2026 its first-day market cap would likely be the highest among all 2026 IPOs, barring a huge rival like Ant Group. The main uncertainty is an IPO occurring at all given US-China regulatory tensions, but a ~5% chance is far above the market's implied 0.2%.
evidence_points: ByteDance last valued around $300B, far exceeding typical IPO market caps
Record tech IPO market cap is Alibaba's $168B, which ByteDance would likely surpass
Geopolitical hurdles and TikTok divesture demands obscure the IPO timeline, but not enough to justify 0.2%
sources_consulted: Historical IPO market cap data (Alibaba, etc.)
